Name: More Lively Farm Cave
Author: Aimon111
Description:
[center][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][i][color=#fff2cc]Just a simple vanilla Farm Cave replacement, with abitily to plant crops, catch fish and swim in the pool.[/color][/i]

This map inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5849]Hot Spring FarmCave[/url]﻿ made by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/9139916]DustBeauty[/url], check it out if you want, it's gorgeous![/size][/font][/center]

[line]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://imgur.com/sxHCl8A.png[/img][/font][/size]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Dig dirt and plant crops (works like greenhouse)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Catch fish in pond (ghostfish, carps and algae)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Swim in hot spring[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Travel via minecart (connected to vanilla minecart system)[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Choose your farmcave style[/font][/size]
[line]
[font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://imgur.com/GqZYehL.png[/img]
[size=3][color=#d9ead3][b]Compatible:[/b][/color][/size][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Expansions like Stardew Valley Expanded, Ridgeside Village, East Scarpe, ect...[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Recolors and retextures. [/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]More Lively Meadowlands Farm (automatic compatibility, no need to disable farmcave in it's config)[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]PolyCarts[/size][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]-----------------------------
[color=#fff2cc][b]Compatible [/b][/color]with farm maps (but make sure to disable farmcave replacement option if they have it)
------------------------------
[color=#ea9999][b]Not compatible[/b][/color] with mods that replace FarmCave map.[/size][/font]
[line]
[font=Trebuchet MS][img]https://imgur.com/lMF7LuG.png[/img][/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://legacy.curseforge.com/linkout?remoteUrl=https%253a%252f%252fwww.nexusmods.com%252fstardewvalley%252fmods%252f1915]Content Patcher[/url][/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3](Optional) Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/28423]MMAP[/url] if you want dynamic lightrays and fireflies to spawn in FarmCave.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS](Recommended) On new save files: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27985]Mushroom Box Location Framework[/url] mod for fixing the mushroom boxes.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Unzip "Aimon's More Lively Farm Cave" archive into Stardew\Mods folder.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size][/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]Enjoy![/size][/font][/*]
[/list][line]
[left][url=https://postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t][img]https://i.postimg.cc/Wtyh7j7t/config-options.png[/img][/url]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Farmcave Recolor:[/b] Changes the look of farmcave walls and ground.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]    Available recolors: [/font][/size]
[spoiler]
[font=Trebuchet MS]Undeground,[/font]
[font=Trebuchet MS] Lush,
Frost,
Sea,
Desert,
Quarry,
Volcano,
Mushroom,
Slime[/font][/spoiler]
[list]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Swim in Farmcave pond: [/b]Toggles pool entrance tiles in FarmCave bridge. Set this to false if you have Swim mod installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Bridge: [/b]Adds wooden bridge across the farmcave pond.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Dynamic Lightrays:[/b] Toggles animated lightrays in farmcave if MMAP is installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Fireflies:[/b] Toggles fireflies spawn in farmcave if MMAP is installed.[/font][/size][/*]
[*][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b]Minecart:[/b] Adds minecart into farmcave which is connected to vanilla minecarts system.[/font][/size][/*]
[/list]-----------------------------
[font=Trebuchet MS][size=3][b][color=#ffe599]Mushroom Box spawnpoints fix:[/color][/b]
[u][b]- Before creating new save file:[/b][/u] install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27985]Mushroom Box Location Framework[/url] mod, it will automatically relocate the boxes.

[u][b]- On already existing save files: [/b][/u][/size]
[/font]
[list=1]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]load your save file[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]manually remove everything from your farmcave or else they will despawn on next stage (includes craftables, furniture, crops, fruit trees and other items)[/font][/*]
[*][font=Trebuchet MS]put this command in SMAPI console:[/font][/*]
[/list][code]world_clear farmcave removable[/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]    *this command will remove everything from the farmcave

[/font][/size]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]  4. put these 2 commands in SMAPI console:[/font][/size]
[code]player_add (BC)128 6[/code][font=Trebuchet MS][size=3]   *will add 6 Mushroom Box items into your inventory[/size]
[/font]
[code]player_add (BC)Dehydrator 1[/code][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]   *will add 1 Dehydrator item into your inventory[/font][/size]
[center][line]
[size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#ffe599]Mods used on screenshots:[/color][/b][/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]---------------------------- [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Vibrant Pastoral Recolor [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Mushroom Box to Log[/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Simple Foliage [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Better Water 2 [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]Visible Fish [/font][/size][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS]---------------------------- [/font][/size][/center]
[center][/center]
[center][size=3][font=Trebuchet MS][b][color=#d5a6bd]Thank you for playing[/color]![/b] ❤️[/font][/size][/center]
[/left]
